decisions.reason: Healthcare and hospitality recruitment sits furthest from the firm's maritime knowledge base, which limits its ability to interpret results and improve the service, but its existing global crewing and recruitment infrastructure makes it cheap enough to keep for now.
Superyacht crew recruitment builds directly on the firm's core crewing know-how and seafarer network, so the firm can readily absorb market feedback and refine the service.
The Smart Academy extends the firm's established training centres and is quickly growing a partner network of maritime institutions, which strengthens its knowledge inflow.
FuelEU monitoring and compliance draws on core technical management expertise, has shown clear early success with all plans submitted before the deadline, and meets an ongoing regulatory need.
The dashboard is integrated into the firm's own PAL software and builds on its digital and compliance knowledge, supporting its strategic push into digitalisation and environmental performance.
The cost simulator uses the same in-house software and emissions-regulation know-how as the dashboard, giving clients decision support at low incremental cost to the firm.
